handle_local_states: handle local states in a stateful model by extracting them into a functional wrapper and initial state dictionary
freeze_local_states: freeze local states in a handled model by embedding state values as FrozenLocalStateRequest instances
hoist_shared_state_requests: hoist shared state requests out of a pytree into a separate dictionary for easier model manipulation
embed_shared_state_requests: embed shared state requests back into a pytree from a dictionary of InitialLocalStateRequest or FrozenLocalStateRequest
create_InitialLocalStateRequest: create an InitialLocalStateRequest with a state initializer, category, and optional name for configuring initial model state
